calc_items.title: Arterial O₂ content (Day 18 repair)
calc_items.question: A child has haemoglobin 15 g/dL and SaO₂ 88%. Ignoring dissolved oxygen, calculate the arterial oxygen content CaO₂ (mL O₂/dL), to one decimal place.
calc_items.working: CaO₂ = 1.34 × Hb × SaO₂ fraction = 1.34 × 15 × 0.88 = 17.688 ≈ 17.7 mL O₂/dL. The decimal 0.88 (not 88) is essential.
calc_items.trap: Convert the saturation percentage to a fraction before multiplying.
